task1.title: IELTS Writing Task 1 — Line Graph — Transport Modes
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.
task1.prompt: The graph below shows the percentage of people using different modes of transport to commute to work in a European city between 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.data_description: Line graph: Car usage rose from 45% (2000) to 55% (2010) then fell to 40% (2020). Bus usage declined steadily from 30% to 15%. Train usage increased from 10% to 35%. Cycling grew from 5% to 10%.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Does the response cover all key features with data? Are comparisons made?
band_descriptors.coherence: Is there a clear overview? Are paragraphs logically organised?
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Are varied vocabulary and precise data descriptions used?
band_descriptors.grammar: Are complex sentence structures used accurately?

task2.title: IELTS Writing Task 2 — Opinion Essay — University Education

task1.prompt: The graph below shows the daily coffee consumption per person in five countries from 1990 to 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.data_description: Line graph: Finland: 5 cups → 6.5 cups. Italy: 4 → 5.5. USA: 3 → 4. Brazil: 2 → 4.5. Japan: 1 → 3.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Are all countries covered? Are growth rates compared?
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Are trend verbs used (rose steadily, overtook, remained highest)?
band_descriptors.grammar: Are past tenses used consistently?

task1.prompt: The diagram below shows how chocolate is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.data_description: Process: Cacao pods harvested → beans extracted → fermented → dried → roasted → crushed → cocoa butter extracted → mixed with sugar and milk → moulded into bars.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Are all stages described in order?
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Are process verbs used (extracted, fermented, moulded)?
band_descriptors.grammar: Is the passive voice used consistently?

task1.title: IELTS Writing Task 1 — Map — Town Centre Redevelopment
